results.name: negative-literal-attribute

diagnostics.message: attribute 'tabindex' on <section> is a bare '-' expression (not wrapped in a function), which the compiler cannot evaluate in /home/runner/work/forma-app-platform/forma-app-platform/spikes/APP-003/admin/.cache/refusals/negative-literal-attribute/app.tsx:49:117 — the attribute is OMITTED from the server-rendered HTML and hydration does not re-apply a non-function prop, so it never appears — inline the literal, use a module-level const, or wrap it in a function (`() => …`) for a reactive binding
diagnostics.why: The attribute has no supported native value, so the build refuses the page instead of publishing HTML with an omitted attribute.
diagnostics.fix: Pass the computed value as its own declared prop, inline a literal or module-level const, or declare the component with browserOnly() (`const X = browserOnly(Impl)` from @getforma/core) and register it in activateIslands, so it renders in the browser alone.
